reviews.comment: If possible, please avoid this instructor. Due to disorganized and confusing lectures, navigating this course as a whole was quite challenging. I also found it difficult to communicate with him effectively. That being said, I think he could improve his teaching skills if he prepared more thoroughly.

Very confusing grading criteria and unexpectedly harsh grading for final report. Did not know what my grade was at all until the very end and no clear guidelines w strict grading. Will occasionally take attendance. I would take MGMT466 with someone else.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
No clear rubric for work and grading criteria is unique to say the least is really my only complaint. 
Attend class, do the work, read in between the lines on what is wanted for assignments, and make your presence known in the class and you will be fine.
Lots of potential for this to be a great class, just needs more structure and clear cut grade.

Course material isn't hard, taught myself the whole class in 3 days for the final, quizzes are ridiculously difficult but the curve at the end helps. Easy grader on final and projects. Can't see quiz feedback or individual grades and his communication was poor and the syllabus changed several times. Poorly run class but A is definitely manageable.

I think this was Lee's first semester teaching, but I would say he did okay for it. Course structure seemed a bit unorganized so it was hard to calculate my grade till the very very end. Course itself was fairly easy, just have a decent group and you'll be fine. He gave quizzes that were really hard, but he just curved them all up anyway.
